guides.definition: Defines a JUnit Jupiter test method with an explicit expected and actual value. Test-project dependency only: configure JUnit Jupiter in Maven, Gradle, or the IDE; the isolated Java runner does not resolve test engines.

examples.title: Verify addition
examples.explanation: A descriptive method name states the behavior while assertEquals reports both expected and actual values on failure.

guides.definition: Runs one JUnit Jupiter test method for every CsvSource row. Test-project dependency only: configure JUnit Jupiter in Maven, Gradle, or the IDE; the isolated Java runner does not resolve test engines.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Method parameters matching each CSV row.

parameters.name: expectedExpression
parameters.description: Expected value passed to the assertion.

examples.title: Verify string lengths
examples.explanation: Parameterized tests keep identical behavior checks in one method while preserving each case as a distinct test invocation.

guides.definition: Verifies the exception type and keeps the thrown instance available for message checks. Test-project dependency only: configure JUnit Jupiter in Maven, Gradle, or the IDE; the isolated Java runner does not resolve test engines.

examples.title: Reject an invalid argument
examples.explanation: assertThrows fails when no exception or the wrong type is thrown and returns the matching exception for further assertions.
